content:
sophia: quick thought during stand: we need a small, unambiguous exposure contract for server-side error taxonomy -> what we show to customers. current problem: same internal tag is leaking inconsistent messages into console and SDKs.
luke: yes. proposal: separate the canonical error 'type' from an explicit `exposure_level` that controls surface behavior. don't couple routing tiers to UX.
anya: agree. what levels do you want? internal, soft_expose, customer_visible, retired?
sophia: exactly. semantics:
 - internal: stored only in logs/metrics, never surfaced to clients.
 - soft_expose: minimal hint in SDK + faint console badge, no hard-failure text.
 - customer_visible: full error block in response, docs link, suggested fallbacks.
 - retired: same as internal but also marked for deprecation.
kevin: can we keep the enum stable and small? also add an `exposure_reason` short string for runbooks.
olivia: UX: soft_expose should be gray/yellow micro-pill with text like "Service degraded  auto fallback" (tooltip -> runbook). customer_visible is red with a clear CTA: "Choose fallback -> docs".
anya: telemetry request: surface `exposure_level` and `route_shard` as dimensions so we can correlate quality regressions to specific pools. also emit `exposure_promotion_count` when an internal error becomes soft_expose.
kevin: rollout heuristics idea: only promote internal->soft_expose when one of:
  * >= 1k affected requests in 48h AND rate >= 0.05% of total traffic
  * or manual triage via runbook approval.
luke: +1 to the numeric gate but add a safety: promotion is blocked unless a runbook file exists in the infra docs repo. CI will check for a runbook link in the error registry entry.
sophia: backwards compat: add header `X-Redwood-Exposure: soft_expose` for clients that don't parse JSON. also include `exposure_level` in response body under `meta.error_exposure`. example response for soft_expose: ```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "ROUTE_DEGRADED",
    "message": "partially degraded, auto-fallback applied",
    "meta": { "error_exposure": "soft_expose", "client_hint": "retry_short" }
  }
}
```
kevin: SDK change: surface `meta.error_exposure` on exception objects and expose a convenience `isCustomerVisible()` helper.
telemetry-bot: note: added metric templates `errors.v1.count` + tags: `error_code`, `exposure_level`, `route_shard`, `customer_tier`.
anya: dashboard ask: new "Exposure Rollup" board showing promotion events, false-positive rate (cases where soft_expose showed but no fallback needed), and token-cost delta pre/post promotion.
olivia: console: add an admin switch per-org to opt-in to `customer_visible` for specific codes. default should be global policy. toggles must be audited.
sophia: escalation policy: if false-positive rate > 1% in 24h after promotion -> auto rollback exposure to internal and page oncall.
luke: deployment plan: runtime change is non-breaking if default is `internal` when field missing. feature flag `exposure_gate_v1` to control promotions. canary rollout: 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 24h observation windows.
kevin: tests: add unit tests for header parsing, SDK fixture tests to ensure helper present, and e2e for header + JSON presence.
anya: docs: central registry entry for every error code must include `description`, `runbook_link`, `default_exposure`, and `suggested_fallbacks`. CI will reject registry entries without runbook_link.
sophia: quick sample runbook snippet to include in the registry: ```
Title: ROUTE_DEGRADED
Symptoms: elevated 503s from pool X, auto-fallback to model-small observed
Initial triage: check pool health, kernel error logs, prefix cache hit-rate
Rollback criteria: false-positive > 1% within 24h or recovery not observed in 2h
Contact: @oncall-routing
```
telemetry-bot: created dashboard stub "Exposure Rollup (canary)". seed data for last 30 days available.
olivia: UI TODO: add pill variants + tooltip copy. I'll submit small PR.
sophia: action items: 1) eng-runtime: add `exposure_level` and `client_hint` fields and header (default internal). 2) eng-platform: console toggles & badges. 3) devx: SDK helpers and tests. 4) eng-sre: alert for false-positive rollback. 5) docs: error registry CI rule.
kevin: I've claimed runtime PR. aiming for next Tue deploy window.
anya: I'll build dashboard queries and an alert rule for false-positive > 0.5% as a softer start.
sophia: thanks all 44d schedule a follow-up after first canary wave.
dev-bot: ticket created RI-EX-9001: exposure-level-enforcement, flag=exposure_gate_v1 set to false.
telemetry-bot: reminder: instrument traces with `exposure_level` for flame-graph correlation.
sophia: wrap-up: keep error codes stable, change only exposure. small, reversible, instrumented. check-in next Wed 09:00.
